audit.why: The decisive interactions are already stated and match Riot's text: Terrashape (W) dashes 1100 on a flat 7s and is what enchants the weapon, Audacity (E) is a 650 dash onto you at 11/10/9/8/7, and Supreme Display of Talent (R) is a 950-range shockwave that stuns by DETONATING the element she is carrying — so fighting away from enchantable terrain removes the stun. Her Q at 525 carries the element's bonus effect only while enchanted. Nothing to correct here.
